scene nightsky
It was a normal night at a local bar.
Unfortunately, the word “normal” had taken on a new meaning for its proprietor recently.
Or perhaps it would be more accurate to say it had taken on an older one.
One where the baseline was lowered from somewhere near happy to somewhere closer to the dirt.
This had good and bad sides, you see.
The good was that the slightest thing now could turn an average day into a great one.
The bad was that, despite how much easier it would be to improve at this point, things seldom seemed to click.
And that statement applied to more than just one person as you’ll see shortly.
scene sarasadayanebar1

scene sarasadayanebar3

scene sarasadayanebar2

Let alone a torso-sized cock that had been inside of her as well.
It was a great cock.
Strong.
Solid girth.
The best cock that she and her daughter ever had.

scene sarasadayanebar4

: Did Sana send you here to talk to me?
: No, but...I’d be lying if I said it wasn’t because of her that I’m here.
: She still hasn’t...confronted you about...anything, uhh...disturbing lately...has she?
scene sarasadayanebar5
: Oh, good. So you know too then. Wonderful.
: Sara-
scene sarasadayanebar6

: And talking about it is?
: Which part, exactly? The one where my daughter is seeing the same guy as me? Or the part where she wants me to join in so we can see him together?
: That’s-
scene sarasadayanebar7

scene sarasadayanebar8

: Why?...It’s the truth and you know it.
: I’m the one who raised her. And I set an example by also screwing my teacher when I was her age.

scene sarasadayanebar9

scene sarasadayanebar10

: Psht. The only thing I know is that we’re all the same at your age apparently.
: Maybe so. But I can also tell you that, if my mom were still here, I wouldn’t do what Sana did. That was wrong on every level possible, Sara.
: And I’m here to tell you it’s not your fault since she won’t.
: So please...can we talk? Like, really talk? I’ll tell you everything.

scene black

scene sarasadayanebar12

scene sarasadayanebar13

scene sarasadayanebar14

scene sarasadayanebar20

: I think you do too, Ayane. That’s not what I meant by “alone.”

scene sarasadayanebar21

scene sarasadayanebar22

scene sarasadayanebar23
